summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title), which returns a Control with one unstyled segment and one title control code. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor; it buffers the control only when is_terminal is true, returns True or False, and has no Windows calls. rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_console.py test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), test_control.py test_control_title, and test_windows_renderer.py test_control_set_window_title (Windows only). Not run: tests and Black were not executed, per the instructions, so formatting and test results are unverified. No commits were made.
